scanNote:
3-MODUL O'Z-O'ZINI BAHOLASh (90-bet). Yuqorida yashil 'Module Self-Assessment 3 (Units 9 - 12)'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Vocabulary':
1) 'Underline the correct item.' 1 The salt was carried up to the UNDERGROUND/SURFACE by the miners. 2 Don't touch the wire or else you'll give yourself an electric BURN/SHOCK. 3 Cleaning PRODUCTS/GOODS should be kept away from children. 4 Traffic ACIDS/FUMES pollute the air in cities. 5 The building was DESTROYED/CARVED by fire. 6 Oxygen is one of our most BASIC/PUBLIC needs. 7 If I were the leader of my country, I would PRODUCE/IMPROVE living conditions. 8 Check the price guide for THRILLING/CURRENT prices. 9 They JOINED/MET the golf club last August. 10 We asked for information at the MEETING/RECEPTION desk. 11 ACID/CURRENT rain can damage buildings. 12 It's very important to help animals live SAFELY/DEEPLY. (10 marks)
2) 'Fill in the correct word:' qiya 'rare, species, public, boiling, mobile, outdoor, book, admission, opening, drowning'. 1 The weather here is ...... hot. 2 Dog-sledding and skiing are ...... activities. 3 A lot of ...... plants die when we destroy the rainforest. 4 ...... transport is cheap and convenient in this city. 5 The lifeguard saved the child from ...... . 6 ...... your holiday now and prepare for the most exciting experience of your life. 7 ...... to the museum is free of charge. 8 The ...... of the new gallery will be on Tuesday 3rd March. 9 There are several ...... of birds in the rainforest. 10 You can use a ...... phone wherever you go. (10 marks)
3) 'Fill in the missing preposition:' qiya 'for, to, by, in, of, with'. 1 Don't let children play ...... knives. 2 There is no answer ...... the problem. 3 The party was full ...... fun and surprises. 4 Three people were injured ...... the accident. 5 The hotel is ...... the heart of Kent. 6 Jamaica is the ideal place ...... a holiday. 7 Enjoy your drink and relax ...... the pool. 8 Cover electrical sockets when they are not ...... use. (8 marks)

O'NG USTUN - 'Grammar':
SURAT: do'konda ikki ayol (sotuvchi va xaridor), oyoq kiyimlar javoni.
4) 'Underline the correct word.' 1 Shop assistants MUST/CAN be polite to customers. 2 I'm afraid you CAN'T/DON'T HAVE TO park here. 3 You HAVE TO/MUSTN'T smoke in the hospital. 4 I HAVE TO/CAN wake up early tomorrow, because my flight leaves at 9 am. 5 You MUSTN'T/DON'T HAVE TO be rude to your teacher. (5 marks)
5) 'Match the questions to the answers.' A: 1 Do I have to clean the windows? 2 Can I go now? 3 Did you have to wear a uniform then? 4 Am I allowed to keep a pet in my hotel room? 5 Can I swim near the rocks? B: a Of course, you can. b No, you aren't, I'm afraid. c No, you don't. I did them yesterday. d No, you mustn't. e Yes, I did. (5 marks)
6) 'Rewrite the sentences in the passive.' 1 We MUST FIT safety gates at the top and bottom of these stairs. 2 The Russians LAUNCHED Sputnik 1 in 1957. 3 The hotel OFFERS excellent service. 4 Many people HAVE VISITED the museum so far. 5 Hitchcock DIRECTED The Birds. 6 The Mayor WILL OPEN the museum this Friday. (12 marks)

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '90'.

exercises.explanationUz:
9-12 UNITLAR LUG'ATI.

JAVOBLAR:
  1 surface  2 shock  3 products
  4 fumes  5 destroyed  6 basic

items.textEn: 1 The salt was carried up to the underground/surface by the miners.
items.uz: 1 Tuzni konchilar yer yuzasiga olib chiqishdi.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'carried UP to the SURFACE' = yuzaga olib chiqmoq.

items.textEn: 2 Don't touch the wire or else you'll give yourself an electric burn/shock.
items.uz: 2 Simga tegmang, aks holda tok uradi.

items.textEn: 3 Cleaning products/goods should be kept away from children.
items.uz: 3 Tozalash vositalari bolalardan uzoqda saqlanishi kerak.

items.textEn: 4 Traffic acids/fumes pollute the air in cities.
items.uz: 4 Mashina tutuni shaharlarda havoni ifloslantiradi.

items.textEn: 5 The building was destroyed/carved by fire.
items.uz: 5 Bino yong'indan vayron bo'ldi.

items.textEn: 6 Oxygen is one of our most basic/public needs.
items.uz: 6 Kislorod eng asosiy ehtiyojlarimizdan biri.

items.textEn: 7 If I were the leader of my country, I would produce/improve living conditions.
items.uz: 7 Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, turmush sharoitlarini yaxshilardim.

items.textEn: 8 Check the price guide for thrilling/current prices.
items.uz: 8 Joriy narxlar uchun narxlar ko'rsatkichini tekshiring.

items.textEn: 9 They joined/met the golf club last August.
items.uz: 9 Ular o'tgan avgustda golf klubiga a'zo bo'lishdi.

items.textEn: 10 We asked for information at the meeting/reception desk.
items.uz: 10 Biz qabulxona stolida ma'lumot so'radik.

items.textEn: 11 Acid/Current rain can damage buildings.
items.uz: 11 Kislotali yomg'ir binolarga zarar yetkazishi mumkin.

items.textEn: 12 It's very important to help animals live safely/deeply.
items.uz: 12 Hayvonlarga xavfsiz yashashga yordam berish juda muhim.

JAVOBLAR:
  1 boiling  2 outdoor  3 rare
  4 Public  5 drowning  6 Book

items.uz: Bu yerda ob-havo qaynoq issiq.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing preposition. (8 marks)
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:
  1 with  2 to  3 of  4 in  5 in
  6 for  7 by  8 in


⚠ PREDLOGLI IBORALAR:

  play WITH knives = pichoq bilan
    o'ynamoq
  answer TO the problem = muammoga
    yechim
  full OF = ...ga to'la
  injured IN the accident = baxtsiz
    hodisada jarohatlangan
  IN the heart OF = markazida
  ideal place FOR = ... uchun ideal
  relax BY the pool = basseyn
    YONIDA dam olmoq
  not IN use = ishlatilmayotgan


⚠ 'BY THE POOL' va 'IN THE POOL':

  by = yonida; in = ichida.
  'relax BY the pool' - ichimlik
  bilan yonida.

items.uz: Bolalarga pichoq bilan o'ynashga ruxsat bermang.

items.sentence: 5 The hotel is ___ the heart of Kent.

items.sentence: 6 Jamaica is the ideal place ___ a holiday.
items.uz: Yamayka ta'til uchun ideal joy.

items.sentence: 7 Enjoy your drink and relax ___ the pool.
items.uz: Ichimligingizdan bahramand bo'ling va basseyn yonida dam oling.

items.sentence: 8 Cover electrical sockets when they are not ___ use.

exercises.explanationUz:
MODAL FE'LLAR (10-unit):

  must = kerak (majburiyat)
  mustn't = mumkin emas (taqiq)
  can = mumkin (ruxsat)
  can't = mumkin emas
  have to = kerak (tashqi majburiyat)
  don't have to = shart emas


JAVOBLAR:
  1 must - xushmuomala BO'LIShI
    KERAK
  2 can't - bu yerda mashina qo'yish
    MUMKIN EMAS
  3 mustn't - kasalxonada chekish
    TAQIQLANGAN
  4 have to - parvoz 9 da → erta
    turishga MAJBUR
  5 mustn't - qo'pol bo'lish
    MUMKIN EMAS


⚠ 'I'M AFRAID':

  = afsuski (muloyim).


⚠ 'RUDE':

  = qo'pol.
  ⚠ 'polite' = xushmuomala.

items.textEn: 1 Shop assistants must/can be polite to customers.
items.uz: 1 Sotuvchilar xaridorlarga xushmuomala bo'lishi kerak.

items.textEn: 2 I'm afraid you can't/don't have to park here.
items.uz: 2 Afsuski, bu yerda mashina qo'yish mumkin emas.

items.textEn: 3 You have to/mustn't smoke in the hospital.
items.uz: 3 Kasalxonada chekish mumkin emas.

items.textEn: 4 I have to/can wake up early tomorrow, because my flight leaves at 9 am.
items.uz: 4 Ertaga erta turishim kerak, chunki parvozim 9 da.

items.textEn: 5 You mustn't/don't have to be rude to your teacher.
items.uz: 5 O'qituvchingizga qo'pol bo'lish mumkin emas.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the questions to the answers. (5 marks)
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:
  1 - c  (Do I have to? → No, you
         don't.)
  2 - a  (Can I? → Of course, you
         can.)
  3 - e  (Did you have to? → Yes,
         I did.)
  4 - b  (Am I allowed? → No, you
         aren't.)
  5 - d  (Can I swim? → No, you
         mustn't. - xavfli)


⚠ QISQA JAVOBLAR:

  Do I have to? → Yes, you do. /
    No, you don't.
  Did you have to? → Yes, I did. /
    No, I didn't.
  Am I allowed to? → Yes, you are.
    / No, you aren't.
  Can I? → Yes, you can. / No, you
    can't (mustn't).


⚠ 'TO BE ALLOWED TO':

  = ruxsat berilgan bo'lmoq.

pairs.left: 1 Do I have to clean the windows?
pairs.right: c No, you don't. I did them yesterday.
pairs.rightUz: Yo'q, shart emas. Men kecha tozaladim.

pairs.left: 3 Did you have to wear a uniform then?
4 Am I allowed to keep a pet in my hotel room?
pairs.right: b No, you aren't, I'm afraid.
pairs.leftUz: Mehmonxona xonamda uy hayvoni saqlashga ruxsat bormi?

pairs.left: 5 Can I swim near the rocks?

exercises.instructionEn: Rewrite the sentences in the passive. (12 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni majhul nisbatda qayta yozing. (12 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
MAJHUL NISBAT (9-unit):
  BE + PAST PARTICIPLE (+ by ...)


JAVOBLAR:

  1 Safety gates MUST BE FITTED at
    the top and bottom of these
    stairs.
    (must + be + V3)
  2 Sputnik 1 WAS LAUNCHED by the
    Russians in 1957.
    (past simple: was + V3)
  3 Excellent service IS OFFERED by
    the hotel.
    (present simple: is + V3)
  4 The museum HAS BEEN VISITED by
    many people so far.
    (present perfect: has been + V3)
  5 The Birds WAS DIRECTED by
    Hitchcock.
    (past simple)
  6 The museum WILL BE OPENED by
    the Mayor this Friday.
    (future: will be + V3)


⚠ QOIDA:

  Faol gapdagi TO'LDIRUVChI →
  majhul gapning EGASI.
  Faol gapdagi EGA → 'by ...'
  ('we', 'people' kabi umumiy ega
  tushiriladi).


⚠ 'TO FIT':

  = o'rnatmoq. fit - fitted.


⚠ 'TO LAUNCH':

  = uchirmoq (kosmosga).


⚠ 'THE MAYOR':

  = shahar hokimi. /meə/.

items.textEn: 1 We must fit safety gates at the top and bottom of these stairs. → Safety gates ___ at the top and bottom of these stairs.
2 The Russians launched Sputnik 1 in 1957. → Sputnik 1 ___ in 1957.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Past simple majhul: 'was launched by the Russians'.

items.textEn: 3 The hotel offers excellent service. → Excellent service ___.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Present simple majhul: 'is offered by the hotel'.

items.textEn: 4 Many people have visited the museum so far. → The museum ___ so far.
items.answer: has been visited by many people
items.whyUz: ⚠ Present perfect majhul: 'has been visited by many people'.

items.textEn: 5 Hitchcock directed The Birds. → The Birds ___.
6 The Mayor will open the museum this Friday. → The museum ___ this Friday.
items.answer: will be opened by the Mayor
items.whyUz: ⚠ Kelasi zamon majhul: 'will be opened by the Mayor'.

patterns.exampleEn: Sputnik 1 was launched by the Russians in 1957.
You mustn't smoke in the hospital.

patterns.formula: Do I have to ...? - No, you don't.
patterns.exampleEn: Do I have to clean the windows? - No, you don't.
patterns.exampleUz: Derazalarni tozalashim kerakmi? - Yo'q, shart emas.
